rows.en: This is <cs(1)>UCE<ce()> HQ, Dermail speaking. I've already received the report on this incident.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: The <cs(1)>Poseidal Army<ce()> is from Pentagona and has lately invaded the Earth Sphere for spoils.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: We've long had our eye on them, but I never thought they'd target a place like this...
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: I want you of the <cs(1)>Ra Cailum<ce()> to take up the pursuit mission at once.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: Keep the base's survivors aboard your ship under protection until things settle down.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: Put civilians to work if useful. Top priority: recover the stolen classified material.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: Whatever it takes, I expect a swift deployment.
rows.speaker: Dermail

rows.en: So you're just a ragtag unit after all. It seems I was a fool to expect anything of you.
rows.speaker: Dermail
